concerns.text: The plan uses the DFT activation barrier as a surrogate for experimental TOF (see ‘experimental TOF data are unavailable; the DFT activation barrier will serve as a surrogate target’). This substitution undermines construct validity: the target variable no longer measures catalytic turnover frequency, so the study cannot directly answer the stated research question about predicting TOF.

Success Criterion SC‑001 specifies “Pearson R ≥ 0.80 and MAE ≤ 20 % of TOF range” yet the pipeline never obtains real TOF values. Computing these metrics on the surrogate activation‑barrier target is inconsistent with the criterion and may lead to misleading claims of predictive performance for TOF.
